title: sorghastrum linnaeanum
intro: Sorghastrum linnaeanum, commonly known as Indiangrass, is a perennial warm-season grass native to the prairies of North America. It is known for its numerous health benefits, including the ability to lower cholesterol and blood pressure, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Indiangrass include its ability to exhibit antioxidant and anti-diabetic activities, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Sorghastrum linnaeanum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
